title: EHR screen
description: A vendor-neutral electronic health record screen, 1280 px wide: title bar, a state banner (normal, degraded or read-only, always in words), the patient banner, and one table (a patient list, results review, medication administration record or order entry). All patients are synthetic.

system.description: Name of the clinical record system shown in the title bar. Use a generic name, not a vendor product.

site.description: Facility and environment. Falls back to brand.aliases.org.

clock.description: Date and time the screen shows.

view.description: Which screen: the unit patient list, results review, medication administration record (MAR) or order entry.

state.description: normal: all functions work. degraded: slow, some functions disabled. read_only: a copy of recent data that cannot be changed.

stateMessage.description: The banner text for a degraded or read-only state, including the data-age time for read-only. Omit for normal.
examples: READ-ONLY — data current as of 14:05. Orders and documentation cannot be entered. Use downtime forms.

patient.description: The patient banner. Omit for the patient list view. Every value is synthetic.

flag.description: Row flag, shown in words: abnormal, critical or held (not yet released).

examples: Last refresh 14:12 · 3 results held for validation
